title: Underived exchange on pointed neighbourhood sections
statement: Let f:X→S be any scheme morphism, s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point, and Q the strict-local neighbourhood geometry [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Write g:S_(s)→S, p:X×_S S_(s)→X, and f′:X×_S S_(s)→S_(s). For a pointed neighbourhood i, define b_i:f_* followed by sections on V_i → p^* followed by global sections to be restriction to S_(s) [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-localized-hom-germ], followed by global sections of baseChangeMap [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange], followed by lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso for f′. Then b_i equals sourceStageSectionsIso.hom [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison] followed by sectionsPullbackNat along Q.legs.app i and the inverse upperStarComp for p = Q.legs.app i ≫ t_i [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. This is an equality of natural transformations on abelian etale sheaves on X, with the usual associators of functor composition.

proof.text: Work componentwise on a sheaf F. Use unit_map_baseChangeMap_app, the pushforward-unit form of the mate, and naturality at the pointed neighbourhood section to replace the mate by the p-unit followed by the square pullback-pasting map. Terminal evaluation and lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso identify its terminal component with the pullback-site arrow psi into p^*V_i. These are proved by the private terminalEvaluation_map_eq_res_forAdjoint and lowerStarSections_eval helpers. The terminal-evaluation helper explicitly quantifies over any HasGlobalSectionsFunctor instance, so it applies to any chosen right adjoint, not only the terminal-object instance.

The private restriction_unit and composition_unit helpers follow from adjunction uniqueness and upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app. Combining them with terminal evaluation proves pointedSections_pullback: a section evaluated after the unit along an arbitrary map into an etale stage equals etaleObjectSectionsIso followed by globalSectionsUpperStarMap and the inverse upperStarComp. This is a complete proof, with no new postponed lemma.

The first projection of psi into V_i times_S X is the strict-henselization cone leg composed with the second limit projection: compute pullback-pasting projections, use the defining pointed section, and apply Q.first. The second projection is p by the site-arrow equation and Q.over. Pullback extensionality therefore identifies it with Q.legs.app i. Apply pointedSections_pullback, identify the etale-object section iso with sourceStageSectionsIso by proof irrelevance, and identify globalSectionsUpperStarMap with sectionsPullbackNat using naturality of terminal evaluation. NatTrans.ext gives the stated equality.

theorem strictLocalUnderivedMateSections_eq {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s)
    (i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) :
    strictLocalUnderivedMateSections f s i =
      (sourceStageSectionsIso f s i).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i))
          (sectionsPullbackNat (Q.legs.app i)) ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)
            ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
            (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) (Q.over i).symm).inv
          (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).smallEtaleTopology
            AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
